'''Scabaras mages''' are monsters encountered during the [[Dealing with Scabaras]] quest within the [[Scabaras Dungeon]]. They can be killed for the [[Scabarites]] slayer assignment. They use an incredibly slow but accurate magic attack. Despite the [[Scabaras lancer]]s and [[Scabaras ranger|ranger]]s in the dungeon being aggressive, the mages will ignore players unless attacked.

They have a special attack in which they will say {{RSChat|You cannot resist the pestilence from the secret places.}} and deal poison damage to the player, though this is only visual and does not inflict poison. They may also summon a poisonous [[scarab swarm]] while in combat, accompanied by saying {{RSChat|May Scabaras's young gnaw upon your bones.}}

==Trivia==
* The [[FunOrb]] game [[Armies of Gielinor]] featured Scabarite mages as a unit for the [[Menaphite Pantheon]] faction. In this game, they were able to poison enemy units with their attacks.
* After they use their special attack or summon a scarab swarm, they will sometimes stop attacking the player and leave combat. This may be a bug.
